title: Expectation of a product over a finite power
statement: Let $alpha$ be a finite type, let $s$ be a natural number, and for each $i<s$ let $f_i:alphatobbr$ be a real-valued function. The uniform expectation over tuples $(y_i)_{i<s}$ of the product $prod_{i<s} f_i(y_i)$ equals the product, over $i<s$, of the uniform expectations of $f_i$.
hypotheses_covered: a real-valued function $f_i$ on $alpha$ for each $i<s$
